title: What to do if you suspect a natural gas leak in your house
desc: Critical safety actions when smelling rotten eggs or hearing whistling near gas lines.
todos: Evacuate everyone from the home immediately without turning lights, appliances, or switches on or off.
Do not ignite matches, lighters, or use phone switches inside the building.
Leave doors open as you exit to allow natural ventilation.
Call 911 and your local gas utility company immediately from a safe distance outside.
Do not re-enter the premises until utility technicians officially declare it safe.
